title: Freeze the health-cancellation fixture clock before its RPC deadline can expire
outcome: A long host stall between holding the authenticated health reply and pausing test time cannot make the cancellation fixture fail for the unrelated RPC timeout.
acceptance: The held-probe fixture prevents expiry of the real RPC deadline before its cancellation measurement begins, while preserving genuine authenticated transport and stop/control-end triggers.
The change retains the explicit exact-child cleanup/replacement assertions, cannot pass through natural RPC expiry, and releases/joins fixture work without inflating production timeouts.
